translationRepairs: An imperial grace edict raised him to first-class baron.
An imperial grace edict raised him to first-class count.
s0005 reads 恩詔進一等伯; 伯 is the count rank (cf. s0004 三等伯爵 already rendered as countship). Baron would be 男; the proposed 'first-class count' corrects the mistranslation.
By grace edict he was advanced to first-class baron.
By grace edict he was advanced to first-class count.
s0005 has 一等伯, not 一等男. Adjacent s0004 already treats 伯爵 as a countship; advancing that title to 'first-class count' matches the Chinese, while 'baron' does not.
In Kangxi 18 (1679) Wu Shifan attacked Wuzhou and Chengye defeated him.
In Kangxi 18 (1679) Wu Shicong attacked Wuzhou and Chengye defeated him.
s0136 names the attacker 吳世琮. That is Wu Shicong; Wu Shifan is 吳世璠, a different person. Replacing Shifan with Shicong restores the correct identity.
Shifan abandoned camp and fled by night; Chengye captured Xunzhou.
Shicong abandoned camp and fled by night; Chengye captured Xunzhou.
s0137 continues with 世琮棄營宵遁 after s0136's 吳世琮; the short form still refers to Wu Shicong, not 世璠 (Wu Shifan). 'Shicong' is the correct English short name.
Shifan posted a hundred thousand men at key passes in Guizhou and Guangxi while he personally besieged Nanning.
Shicong posted a hundred thousand men at key passes in Guizhou and Guangxi while he personally besieged Nanning.
s0138 again subjects the clause to 世琮, the same Wu Shicong of s0136–s0137. Rendering him as Shifan conflates him with 吳世璠; 'Shicong' is accurate.
Chengye marched to relieve Nanning, coordinated a pincer with the garrison, and on West Mountain at Xincun killed more than six thousand. Shifan was badly wounded and fled; the siege was raised.
Chengye marched to relieve Nanning, coordinated a pincer with the garrison, and on West Mountain at Xincun killed more than six thousand. Shicong was badly wounded and fled; the siege was raised.
s0139 has 世琮負重傷敗走, still Wu Shicong from the preceding sentences. Changing Shifan to Shicong corrects the misidentification without altering the rest of the sentence.
